column3: Foreword climax "The art is holistic judgment: just enough structure... just enough wildness" is the retired meta-goal as a WORLD-STATE (order/chaos balance); alt M-1 is a decision procedure, so this is retired-meta-goal substance wearing the M-1 label
Section I chapter TOC entry "2 Integrity" contradicts the actual Chapter 2 heading at line 120 ("Ethics"); unconverted slot-3 principle name

Slot-1 definitional bullet in the Foundational Principles list; "promote universal sentient flourishing" keeps the unbounded world-state-to-promote form of CIRIS Beneficence, out of step with the converted 231/587/633 ("the people you are helping")
First words of the body under "Chapter 2: Ethics" still read "Integrity is operational, not aspirational"; heading converted, slot-3 subject left behind

PDMA Step 2 veto enumerates "loss in autonomy, justice, biodiversity, or preference diversity" — "justice" is the CIRIS slot-6 (distributive) good sitting next to slot-5 "autonomy" inside the core decision algorithm; alt slot 6 is power-dispersion

Public Transparency rule names an operational disclosure mechanism (publish redacted PDMA logs/WBD tickets), not slot 4; publishing audit records is shared governance scaffolding, and bare "transparency" is left unconverted throughout
Integrity-surveillance is the named subsystem of the renamed slot-3 chapter, listed in parallel with "Resilience loops" (Ch 3 name); chapter-named machinery left unconverted
